reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed an issue where controller-assigned IPs did not respect per-proxy DNS capture the same way that ephemeral auto-allocated IPs did", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Controller-assigned IPs now respect per-proxy DNS capture settings consistently with ephemeral auto-allocated IPs; previously they handled DNS capture differently.

proposed.statement: A bug fix ensures controller-assigned proxy IPs honor per-proxy DNS capture configuration the same way ephemeral auto-allocated IPs do.
